headline: Fed Expected to Hold Rates Steady
detail: The Fed holding rates steady is generally positive for growth stocks, but any hint of future hikes could pressure tech. Your leveraged ETFs are particularly vulnerable to rate sentiment.
rec: No action based on this headline alone; monitor Fed commentary for rate path signals.
